changes.text: Draw: header picture keeps the TEAMS/GROUPS bars' margins from the top and sides, also when it grows for all groups
Draw: the teams list fills the left strip to the bottom, teams spread evenly
Draw: all groups stay aligned when they come in (alignment no longer measured on the narrow centre mid-animation)
Draw: flag name as far below the header as above the flag; all groups keep alignment while a row changes
Draw: every text on the screen in capitals
Draw: name above the waving flag, manual steps lock all but the next key, all groups aligned
Draw: show country names in uppercase in overview and centre flag
DRAW: a team just drawn never shows in its group before its waving flag has gone
DRAW: flags in one column in the strips, codes as long as they are
DRAW: no group tags on the left list
DRAW: the row's highlight fades in with the team's flag and code after the waving flag; old row content cross-fades out
DRAW: flags and codes centred in the left list and in the groups
DRAW: the drawn team's flag and code fill its row once the waving flag has gone; the list waits for the flag too
DRAW: no blink of the drawn team's flag and code when its highlight fades on the way back
DRAW tab: the draw keys next to the preview, the groups and setup under it
DRAW: the highlight fades in step with the group going back; the pool row no longer blinks
DRAW: the drawn team's highlight in its group shows without an animation
DRAW: all groups only on the operator's key, also after the last team
DRAW: all groups leave the centre with a fade, then the strips come back
DRAW: flag video loops, rounded like the flags, fades from a still frame; group keeps its colour in the centre; drawn team stays lit until its group goes back
DRAW: every change on the screen animates (flag fades out, rows cross-fade, highlights fade, all-groups view fades out)
DRAW: manual steps (flag off, group back) on keys in the dashboard and Companion, automatic as an option
DRAW: group to the centre before each team, flag videos, strips slide off for all groups, draw matchboard PNG + vMix input, quieter empty places
DRAW: teams go to the group with the fewest teams, waving-flag reveal, full-width all-groups view
RESULTS/COMPARE page: only the groups of the stage picked at the top, no COMPARE PICKED key
DRAW: wider side strips (adjustable, default 300 px) with bigger country rows
DRAW screen: much bigger country codes and flags in both strips and the all-groups view
DRAW screen: strips run the full height, header picture between them (height follows the picture); team list stays in the upper part for the host
DRAW tab: 1/32 Finals draw on the LED wall (vMix Browser input + Companion page) (#23)
Ticker on its own back on channel 1; COMPARE page: each group's comparison and results (A–D from the start); deck pages scroll in Show control
Race flags: C + minus and C + plus without the minus / plus board (plain C)
Race flags back in the original square look (AP pennant, A swallowtail cut, rounded); Announcements in Stream Deck order; drag to reorder versions
Stream Decks for the next stages: 16 team places in group order, team LTs on the team pages, ticker and top ticker on/off
Final Series stages: one click prepares 1/32 Finals to Quarterfinals (groups A–D of four), starred teams first in the pickers
Race flags drawn like the race signals chart; combinations (C + red/green/−/+, AP over 1–3); Announcements sorted: often, combinations, rest
Graphics editor: push an edit only to inputs with exactly that title
Graphics editor: edit any vMix title's texts and pictures from the dashboard
Companion panel: address, live keys switch, push now and status
Companion keys call their place; texts and colours of every key go live
Foldable sections; Show control keeps only Break scene; GTZIP without Scenes; scrollable sync history
Day schedule: Qualification Race as written, like Group H
vMix texts in capitals again, as before 1.0.178 (country names, surnames, positions, groups, people)
Team LT qualified: bottom line QUALIFIED FOR THE FINAL SERIES
Tickers: the text on air is always in capitals, however it was typed
Matchboard: each new PNG goes straight into the vMix titles showing it (ssl_matchboard's image field, any field holding matchboard.png)
Day schedule: a row typed QR / LCR finds the Qualification / Last Chance Race group; test that rows follow the day picked at the top
Day schedule: places of a group with no team yet get the neutral ? flag, known teams their flags
Groups: the Qualification Race takes teams of the stage's groups, which stay in their own group too
Team comparison for the Qualification Race: texts fit themselves (ssl_compare_QR)
vMix texts exactly as typed (no forced capitals); day schedule leaves the flags of unknown group places untouched
Show control: LAST CHANCE EXPLAINED key on the BEFORE page (input ssl_lcr_info)
Commentator page: Publish now always sends fresh data, rounds 20x cheaper, no red stale badge when published by hand
Commentator: calmer layout - one header line, group tabs, plain team cards that open on click, back and next-team buttons
Commentator: light/dark switch, text size, one team in large type with talking points and country facts
Commentator: declared position, number, name in large type; best results always; Group H names; points only; schedule after the next race
Last Chance Race takes teams of the stage's other groups (they stay in their own); its own results and comparison inputs ssl_results_LCR / ssl_compare_LCR with keys
Commentator page publishing: say which setting is missing; accept the R2 endpoint as pasted; the on/off switch saves the form too (#21)
PNG refresh only on the REFRESH PNG key (A BEFORE page): no file checks in the data sync or on key presses
Static commentator page: Cloudflare R2 / S3 upload + back off after failures (#20)
Faster keys: a press sends only the fields the title does not show yet (and pictures whose file changed), a few vMix calls at a time
vMix data: a picture whose file changed (PNG remade in the generator) goes again into every input that shows it
Static commentator page: upload over HTTPS to upload.php (works where FTP is blocked) (#19)
Commentator screen as a static page (FTP) + link button in the top bar (#18)
GTZIP quick form finds every row of the day schedule (rows alike in any order); added schedule rows get their group text
L-BAR RANKING key (ssl_bar_2), no GROUP RESULTS or UNDO keys, the ATEM downstream key on every page, team keys in shirt colours
Companion preset in Companion 5.1's format; the producer's PEOPLE page kept as it is in every preset
Team comparison: team weight always with two decimals
Own results input per group, day schedule toggle in the break scene, flag 4 first in Team comparison, no commentator LT keys
AFTER / BREAK page: a key per ticker for the break scene (new tickers get the next key) instead of NEXT TICKER
Break scene: pick the groups whose results it shows (Show control); none picked = every group but the Last Chance Race
Break scene: the results title of two groups switches cleanly (out, then the next group's data, then in; the data sync follows the group on the board); 1.5 s for the out animation
Break scene without a scene input: L-bar, ticker and schedule/results each on their own overlay channel (2, 3, 4) with their own animations; boards and tickers switch out and in on their channel
Break scene: layers set with a plain comma and the input number (each input on its own layer); NEXT TICKER key with out/in animation
Break scene: its titles play their in animation when it comes in; one of them on another overlay leaves it at once, so it is not left hidden
Break scene: L-bar found as L-bars.gtzip too; boards switch with their out and in animations; switch every 30 s
Break scene: L-bar on layer 1, ticker on layer 3 (TICKERS keys change it in place), day schedule / group results switching on layer 4; AUTO SWITCH on or off, kept
People: Other role lets you type the role
Commentator screen: next race with countdown, races done, Details (photos, best results, team notes), other stages' places, Info (all groups, officials, commentators, socials), larger crew text
Line-up from declaration: a second grinder sits beside the grinder (Main place), the main trimmer moves to Tactician
Schedule board: TIME on/off with centred rows, highlight of the next race; Day/Date/location fields
